name: Wi-Fi NPS Authentication Succeeds but Client Has No Connectivity
checks: Confirm the SSID/WLAN Access VLAN assigned after successful authentication matches the correct site VLAN.
Confirm the client receives a valid DHCP lease from the expected VLAN/subnet.
Confirm the client can reach its VLAN default gateway.
If VLAN, DHCP and gateway are correct, inspect AP/controller RADIUS attributes, session policy and EAP behaviour.
stop_condition: Stop as soon as a wrong VLAN, failed DHCP lease, or failed gateway path explains the symptom.
resolution: Correct the isolated VLAN/DHCP/session configuration; do not change unrelated NPS or EAP settings.
validation: Reconnect or renew the client session.
